root_idea.summary: The root centers on descending, coming down, and arriving at a lower place or position.
root_idea.development: From physical descent and alighting, the lexicon develops senses of settling, bringing something down, progressive delivery, stations or stages, hospitality for one who arrives, and figurative things that befall or descend upon people.

senses.definition: To descend or come down; to alight, settle, or remain in a place.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for downward movement and for arrival at or sojourn in a place; the construction نَزَلَ بِهِ can describe coming down with or bearing something.

senses.definition: To send down or reveal, especially by successive or repeated delivery.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic discourse this form is particularly associated with revelation or other things delivered progressively, in portions, or repeatedly; voice and tense variations do not create separate senses.

senses.definition: To send down, reveal, or bestow from above; to cause something to reach its recipients.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran applies this broad causative to revelation, rain, provisions, clothing, iron, armies, signs, punishment, and other benefits or afflictions; the object may be sent down literally or its causes and guidance may be provided.

senses.definition: To cause a person or thing to descend, alight, or settle at a place.
senses.usage_conditions: This includes the request أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا, ‘cause me to alight at a blessed landing place,’ and is distinct from simply descending oneself.

senses.definition: To descend or come down, often in succession or gradually.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic examples it is used of angels, the spirit, and the divine command or other created agents; it presents the subject as descending or coming down itself.

senses.definition: A place or station of alighting, settlement, or passage; a stage or phase in a sequence.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural مَنَازِل refers to the successive stations or phases assigned to the moon.

senses.definition: Sent down or revealed, with the Form II implication of successive delivery.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive participle referring in the Quran to revelation or a revealed text.

senses.definition: One who sends down or reveals, especially through successive delivery.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle of Form II; the Quranic occurrence presents the agent as the one who sends something down.

quranic_forms.public_pos_label: Passive participle; place noun in one Quranic use · Form IV

senses.usage_conditions: A passive participle of Form IV referring to persons or things caused to descend or sent down.

senses.definition: A place of alighting, landing, or settlement.
senses.usage_conditions: In أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا, مُنْزَلًا functions as the place at which someone is caused to alight.

senses.definition: One who sends down or causes someone or something to alight.
senses.usage_conditions: The active participial plural مُنْزِلُونَ and مُنْزِلِينَ names agents who bring something down or cause it to land.

senses.definition: One who lodges or hosts a person who arrives.
senses.usage_conditions: In the expression خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ, the active participle is understood as one who receives and provides lodging or hospitality.

senses.definition: A descent; one act or instance of descending.
senses.usage_conditions: A countable occurrence of coming down, as in the Quranic expression ‘in another descent.’

senses.definition: Hospitality or provision prepared for one who arrives or is received as a guest.
senses.usage_conditions: The provision may be hospitable fare or an allotted welcome; Quranic contexts apply it both to reward and to the reception of the people of the Fire.

senses.definition: The sending down or revelation of something, especially as a progressive or staged process.
senses.usage_conditions: A Form II verbal noun; in the Quran it commonly denotes revelation delivered or made known in successive stages.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of milk, to descend into or be secreted in the udder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage describing the milk of a ewe or she-camel, including the first milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or occupy the place, position, or condition of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction نَزَلَ مَنْزِلَ كَذَا, ‘to take the position of such a thing.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter or reach a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In a conventional construction such as نَزَلْتُ الْوَادِيَ, the place may be expressed directly, with the sense ‘I entered the valley.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go to Mina, and hence to perform the pilgrimage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage associated with arriving at the pilgrimage station of Mina.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come down against or meet another, especially to engage in combat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of opponents meeting one another in war or battle; the unqualified form can also mean to alight with another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a female animal, to release or excrete milk into or from the udder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited usage includes the secretion of first milk and describes movement either into or out of the udder according to the construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To descend gradually, little by little.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a progressive downward movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To humble oneself or condescend to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with إِلَى to describe lowering oneself socially or figuratively toward someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To relinquish, abdicate, or desist from something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَنْ for giving up a kingdom, possession, position, or course of action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To alight and eat by turns with different people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized reciprocal usage equivalent to taking turns in visiting and eating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone or something to descend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form X causative may refer to physically bringing a person or thing down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To induce someone to relinquish an opinion or position.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively with عَنْ for causing a person to give up a view.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food or rations provided at a halt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This vocalized noun refers to provisions prepared for people stopping at a resting place, not specifically to a guest’s hospitality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A euphemistic term for semen when emitted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical euphemism recorded for the related nouns نُزَالَة and نُزْل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A guest or lodged person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Names one who is received and accommodated by others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who alights or descends.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle denotes a person in the act or condition of alighting; its plural forms are also recorded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A defluxion or downward bodily discharge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized medical or anatomical usage, distinct from the figurative sense of calamity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A severe calamity or affliction that befalls people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative feminine noun; its plural is نَوَازِل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Increase, yield, or beneficial abundance in food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of food that has an added benefit or plentiful yield, as in طَعَامٌ ذُو نُزُل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gathered or compact share or portion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use of a share that is collected together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stretch or space traversed in journeying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to a segment of a route or the distance between stations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Station, standing, rank, grade, or position of honor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively for a person’s social, moral, or general standing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A predicament or situation in which one stands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from a position or station to a circumstance confronting someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Equivalence or similarity between one word and another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression كَلِمَةٌ بِمَنْزِلَةِ كَلِمَةٍ أُخْرَى for a word equivalent or similar to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Use or function in the manner or role of something else.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction يُسْتَعْمَلُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ كَذَا may concern grammatical or administrative function and need not imply equality of meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone resign or relinquish something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَنْ for causing a person to give up a thing, position, or opinion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To impose a request or need upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in constructions such as أَنْزَلْتُ بِكَ حَاجَتِي and أَنْزَلَ حَاجَتَهُ عَلَى كَرِيمٍ for placing one’s need or request upon another.

cautions: Form II is described in the Quran-focused evidence as especially associated with progressive or successive delivery, whereas Form IV is broader and includes general sending down or bestowal.
The مُنْزَل group contains both a passive-participial ‘sent down’ use and the place-noun use in 23:29, despite the supplied morphology grouping.

The Quranic active-participle group normalized to مُنْزِل is distinct from مُنْزَل: the former names an agent who sends down or hosts, while the latter primarily denotes something sent down or a landing place.
